Team —

Quick note to kick off a focused sweep on coverage for the week. Finance ran the send-rate model and the midcase shows a ~28% shortfall vs. Q4 ARR target if current commit rates hold. We need to triage the largest coverage gaps and lock owners for follow-up actions.

Key asks: 
- Please review the attached snapshot (pipe_snapshot_week_of_20261025.xlsx) and update the Stage / Best-Effort Close / Owner columns by Thursday EOD PT.
- Primary metrics to reconcile: pipe-to-goal (coverage ratio), most-likely ARR, and staged closed date.
- For deals with >$150k ACV that are in Negotiation / Legal, add one line describing remaining blocker.

Immediate plan:
1) Marcus: take point on MidMarket deals list (rows 10-47).
2) Laura: lead stage cleanup for Strategic accounts and confirm any reclassifications.
3) Aditya: run a shortfall scenario (best, mid, downside) and produce an action delta with recommended plays by Friday morning.

External note — looping in Sarah from LogiCorp because their renewal sits in Negotiation (see SOW draft attached). Sarah — would you confirm whether procurement expects a PO by Nov 12 or if the date is moving?

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

message_3_subject: Re: Week-of-20261025 pipeline triage: gap-to-goal & owner assignments — action delta
message_3_body:
Thanks — I ran the three scenarios and put the outputs on the sheet under the 'Adj Delta' tab. Short summary below: 

- Best case: +18% coverage (with two MidMarket deals converting as high-likelihood) — still a ~8% net shortfall vs. target.
- Mid case: +6% coverage — ~28% shortfall persists without progressive plays.
- Downside: no change — ~40% shortfall.

Recommended plays (quick list):
1) Acceleration: focus AEs on 3 top-opportunity Negotiation deals (LogiCorp, TH-5200, ST-889) — prioritized call cadence + exec sponsorship.
2) Short-term discount band for escapes under $50k for quick closes to shore runway.
3) Reallocate two SDR resources to thin-funnel strategic accounts for demo slots this week.

I'll prepare a short ops deck for Friday's stand with suggested owner-level KPIs (commit %, next-step cadence).

—Aditya
